description: A Harmonised Building Material Intensity Database for Uncertainty-Aware Building Stock Analysis is published by Pei, Wanyu; Ang, Yu Qian. It describes a harmonised material-intensity database with 2,790 records from 32 countries and accompanying probabilistic-model assets. Spatial scope is global. Spatial resolution is not established here. The full data period remains unverified. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Data format is not established in the metadata reviewed. Licence: GPL-3.0-only metadata umbrella; separate component licences described by the provider. The provider distinguishes 2,739 records in one file from 51 CarbEnMats-derived GPL records. Do not flatten the component licences. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
